export_eft_fitting_to_npz: run the main script to export EFT fitting output with multi-level bounding boxes to NPZ files
validate_smpl_fitting_IsValid: validate SMPL fitting data using IsValid to check beta values and 2D keypoint loss thresholds
validate_smpl_fitting_strict: validate SMPL fitting data using IsValid_strict with stricter beta and keypoint loss thresholds
generate_multilevel_bbox_crops: generate multi-level bounding box crops from face-level to full-body using multilvel_bbox_crop_gen with SMPL vertices
convert_bbox_centerscale_to_xyxy: convert bounding box center and scale representation to XYXY format using conv_bboxinfo_centerscale_to_bboxXYXY
